name: Alfés (Spain)
description: Vertically divided yellow and light green, charged at the centre with two keys in saltire counterchanged.
history: The official flag of Alfés is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, a vertical bicolour of yellow and light green, with the keys in saltire of the arms at the centre of the division, each 5/6 of the height of the cloth, light green where they lie on the yellow and yellow where they lie on the green; approved on 4 March 2010 and published in the DOGC on 26 March 2010.

features.role: two keys in saltire, counterchanged green on the yellow and yellow on the green
segments of the keys on the green half
